items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: The interviewee only provides the last name 'Simon' in response to the interviewer's prompt about a man whose wife lived on Miro Street. There is no evidence of a personal relationship between the interviewee and the wife.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. His first name—I forgot his name.

His wife still lived there on Miro Street. His wife lived on Miro Street, aren't she? I don't know where he was. I know him. I know him. I'm as good as I'm looking at you. I'm looking at him. I can't think of his name. Yeah. His name is not Johnny.
His last name is Simon. His last name is Simon.
